    Class DIContainerTests

    Comprehensive test suite for DIContainer class. Tests singleton registration, factory registration, dependency resolution, circular dependency detection, and error handling.

    Design: Isolated unit tests with proper setup/teardown and dependency management Pros: Thorough coverage, edge case testing, clear test structure, proper DI testing Cons: Requires mock objects, potential test maintenance overhead
